originality.rationale: PASS best of knowledge — The published matroid Tutte polynomial and shellable wedge rank already give nonequivariant rank30. Karn–Nasr–Proudfoot–Vecchi's primary Vámos Section 5 explicitly establishes the **same automorphism group D4×D4**, but its representation is an equivariant Kazhdan–Lusztig coefficient of dimension 33, not the 30-dimensional simplicial top homology character. Moci–Pezzoli provide a general equivariant matroid-homology representation framework; their inspected applications do not compute the complete 25-term Vámos D4×D4 decomposition or the two intrinsic quotient invariant ranks. The explicit signed five-facet exact sequence and asymmetric quotient results are additional. Unindexed older computations of Vámos equivariant characters remain possible.
